d:
Enjoy the enchanting melody "Pari Re Tu Kahan Ki Pari" from Udhar Ka Sindoor. Sung by Asha Bhosle and Mukesh, this evergreen song is a timeless classic that continues to captivate hearts.
Credits:
Song Name: Pari Re Tu Kahan Ki Pari
Singers: Asha Bhosle, Mukesh,
Music: Rajesh Roshan,
Lyrics: Majrooh Sultanpuri
Movie: Udhar Ka Sindur (1976),
Cast: Jeetendra, Reena Roy, Asha Parekh
